page.title: Shopping
page.description: Everything you want to buy, with separate filters for your lists and stock levels.

stockHelp.below_minimum: Stock is below your minimum and needs replenishing.
stockHelp.at_minimum: Stock is at your minimum: an early warning to consider buying more.

guidance.label: How does this list work?
guidance.choice: Each category separates Out, Nearly out and other groceries. Below minimum is Out. Essential at minimum is also Out; nonessential at minimum is Nearly out. This is a replenishment forecast, not an exact count. You choose what to buy.

fields.isEssentialDescription: An essential product is Out at or below minimum. Other products at minimum are Nearly out.
fields.packageSizeDescription: What one package holds, e.g. 200 g; a 6 x 33 cl pack is 198 cl. Lets recipes in grams or litres check the stock.
fields.name: Name
fields.barcodeDescription: The number under the barcode on the packaging.
fields.qrCodeDescription: The code on a label you printed yourself.

add.description: Choose an existing product, enter a name or paste a webshop link.
add.productHint: Search your products. The name, unit and default shop are filled in for you.
add.label: New item
add.placeholder: Add an item or paste a webshop link…
add.previewFailed: Couldn't read the page; the link is saved as is.

project.empty: Nothing to buy for this project.
project.emptyManage: Add what the project needs: from the catalogue, by name or by pasting a webshop link. It goes on the materials list.
project.priceHint: An estimate is fine: the project's budget counts it as committed until it's bought.

lists.search: Search by name, shop or note…
lists.emptyAll: Nothing to buy. Enjoy the empty fridge while it lasts.

listForm.description: For example Weekly groceries, DIY or Pharmacy.
listForm.deleteDescription: The list and everything on it is deleted, including its staples.

staples.title: Staples
staples.description: Things that come back on a list on a schedule.
staples.empty: No staples yet. Add milk, bread or coffee to have them come back every week.
staples.formDescription: It goes back on the list on the day it is due, unless it is still on there.
staples.deleteDescription: It no longer comes back on the list. Items already on the list stay.

shops.title: By shop
shops.description: Where to buy what is on your lists.

shopView.title: Shop view
shopView.description: Combine one or more shops in one view. Tick off what is in your cart.
shopView.chooseShop: Choose a shop or shop group
shopView.noShopDescription: Items without a preferred shop. Buy them anywhere.
shopView.emptyDescription: Everything for this trip is in your cart.
shopView.liveHint: Updated live. Current data reloads after the connection is restored.
shopView.noPrices: No prices yet: add them with the edit button

filters.viewOptionsDescription: Choose the order and what to show on the list.
filters.label: Search and filter
filters.noResultsDescription: Change the search or filters, or clear them.

products.title: Products
products.description: Your household's catalogue: what you buy, where, and for how much.
products.emptyDescription: Add the things you buy often. You can scan their barcode later.
products.formDescription: Products are reused on lists, as staples and in your stock.
products.deleteDescription: It disappears from the catalogue and your stock. Items on lists keep their name.
products.linkDescription: The same product at another shop, with its own link and price.

place.title: To buy for this place
place.empty: Nothing on the shopping list for this place.

storeVisit.title: To buy here
storeVisit.empty: Nothing on the list for this shop.

task.title: Materials
task.empty: This task doesn't need any materials.
task.emptyManage: Add what this job needs: from the catalogue, by name or by pasting a webshop link.

restock.notAdded: Marked as bought. Stock was not added: check the storage location and unit.
restock.unticked: Back on the list. Stock is unchanged; correct a mistaken purchase in Inventory.

errors.generic: That didn't work. Please try again.
errors.favorite: Couldn't update your favourites. Try again.
errors.forbidden: You're not allowed to do that.
errors.packageBoth: Fill in both the amount and the unit, or neither.

autofill.filled: Filled in from the barcode. Check the details and save.
autofill.notFound: Not found. Fill in the details yourself.
autofill.unavailable: Couldn't look this barcode up right now. Fill in the details yourself.

barcodeCache.title: Clean up barcode lookups
barcodeCache.description: Removes product details and photos found by barcode that nobody needed for a long time (found products after 180 days, unknown codes after 30). Photos a saved product uses are kept.

edit.title: Edit item
edit.productHint: Link it to a product from the catalogue, or leave it a loose item.
edit.priceHint: Counts towards the estimate in the shop view.
edit.fetchedNoPrice: Read the page, but it shows no price.

alternatives.title: Alternatives
alternatives.description: Linked products keep their own names and packaging but share a stock count. When counted by pack, each package counts as one pack.
alternatives.none: No alternatives yet. Link another brand of the same thing to share one stock.
alternatives.linkDescription: Products remain distinct but share one stock after linking. When stock counts packs, a 250 g pack and a 500 g pack each count as 1 pack.
alternatives.groupMergeDescription: Continuing will make all products listed below share one stock. Their names, packaging and catalogue details remain separate. One pack counts as one pack.
alternatives.groupMergeConfirm: I confirm that all listed products should share one stock.
alternatives.groupMergeRequired: Please confirm that the other linked products should be included.

errors.category: These products have different categories and cannot automatically share stock. You can still buy a different product during a shopping visit without merging them.
errors.package: Package sizes differ. Treating both as one pack would give incorrect stock counts.
errors.container: Packages aren't comparable. Don't combine their stock without a verified conversion.
errors.unit: Stock units differ and cannot be safely converted.
errors.type: These are different product types, not interchangeable stock.

alternatives.sharedNameDescription: E.g. "Bacon": a new product without a barcode holds the stock, with both as its alternatives.
alternatives.linked: Linked: they share one stock now

productLink.label: Webshop link
productLink.description: The product page at a webshop; pasting one reads its name, photo and price.
productLink.others_one: The main link; {{count}} other shop has its own link (in the product's link menu).
productLink.others_other: The main link; {{count}} other shops have their own link (in the product's link menu).
productLink.forDefaultShop: {{host}} is no known shop: saved as the {{shop}} link.
productLink.chooseShop: Which shop is this link for? Choose it under "Usually bought at".

shopGroups.title: Combine shops and groups
shopGroups.description: Choose multiple shops for this trip, or save a combination as a reusable group.
shopGroups.name: Shop group name
shopGroups.saveHint: Save at least two shops. Items without a shop can be included for a single trip.
shopGroups.removeDescription: Only the group is deleted. Its shops and shopping items stay.
shopGroups.combinedHint: One view for these shops. Each product keeps its original shop, link and price.
shopGroups.duplicateName: A shop group with this name already exists.

sessions.title: Shopping visits
sessions.overviewDescription: Continue an active visit or review previous shopping sessions.
sessions.optionalSuggestions: These are suggestions, not mandatory purchases. Add products or finish whenever you like; ticking nothing is fine.
sessions.noOpenItems: No shopping items left to handle.
sessions.noPurchases: No purchases linked to this visit yet.
sessions.closeConfirmDescription: Finish without ticking every item. Unbought suggestions stay on your regular shopping list; purchases, receipts and payments are kept.
sessions.description: Choose what to buy during this visit.
sessions.deleteConfirmDescription: The visit will disappear from shopping. Unbought suggestions stay on the ordinary list. Real purchases, receipts, payments and stock movements are preserved.
sessions.stockHint: Known stock is credited once when bought. Later receipts link to those acquisitions.
sessions.acceptDifference: I checked the difference; extra goods may be credited
sessions.priorAcquisitions: Earlier goods bought outside this visit
sessions.live_offline: Offline: current data will reload after reconnecting
sessions.adjustDescription: Adjust the quantity or choose any catalogue substitute. After a partial purchase, only shared-stock variants can be switched. No goods are bought here.
sessions.adjustConflict: Someone changed this item. Cancel and reopen Adjust to review the latest values.
sessions.simpleDescription: Choose where you are shopping. Your matching shopping needs become the checklist.
sessions.advancedPlanning: Choose specific needs and other options
sessions.matchingNeeds_one: {{count}} matching item. Current suggestions appear when you start; buying them is never mandatory.
sessions.matchingNeeds_other: {{count}} matching items. The current list is checked again when you start.
sessions.extraNameHint: For something outside the catalogue, give it a name.
sessions.extraDescription: Add another catalogue product or a one-off item to this checklist.
sessions.finishedHint: Your bought goods are recorded below. Add a receipt or link the payment whenever you are ready.
sessions.extraUnitHint: Leave blank to use the product’s known household unit. Use jars or packs when that is what you count.

payments.title: Payments and expenses
payments.splitHint: Record split payments separately with their own references. Linking an existing expense never creates another one.

stockNeedHelp.out: Replenishment forecast: below minimum, or essential and exactly at minimum. This does not necessarily mean zero stock.
stockNeedHelp.nearly_out: Not essential and exactly at minimum: consider picking it up already.
stockNeedHelp.other: Explicitly added or needed for a recipe, without this stock forecast.

need.title: Shopping need
need.reasons: Why it is on the list
need.purchasesHint: A need is a plan. Purchases and their recorded stock effects remain separate facts.
need.removeHint: All linked reasons for this position are removed from the shopping list. Recorded purchases and stock remain.
need.alternatives: Other products that share this stock

shopOffers.title: Products and recorded offers
shopOffers.description: Products linked to this shop in your catalogue. Recorded prices may have changed; availability is not checked.
shopOffers.empty: No catalogue products linked to this shop yet. Open a product to add its shop or offer.
shopOffers.search: Search products, brands or article numbers

collectAndGo.description: Find products and current promotions through the AI assistant. Basket changes always require confirmation; complete orders yourself.
collectAndGo.serverSetup: Administrator: enable the integration on the server, configure INTEGRATIONS_KEY and install the browser. Restart WickedHome afterward.
collectAndGo.desktopLogin: Run this from the WickedHome checkout in a local terminal on your Mac or desktop computer, not an SSH session on the server. Sign in to Collect&Go yourself and select your pickup point in the browser window.
collectAndGo.importInstructions: Transfer the protected session file to your server over SSH and import it with this command. Replace the example path. Delete the plaintext copies after import.
collectAndGo.challenge: Automation stops for a CAPTCHA or expired session. Complete the check yourself with the desktop helper and import again. Prices and promotion conditions can differ by pickup point.
collectAndGo.disconnectDescription: Remove the saved session from WickedHome. Review active sessions in Collect&Go too.
collectAndGo.error: Collect&Go settings could not be loaded.

xtra.description: Use a shared Colruyt connection for product suggestions and the Xtra shopping list.
xtra.sharing: Selected accounts use the same Xtra account and shopping list. Owners manage access; children can only search and read.
xtra.notConfigured: Ask the server administrator to configure the integration encryption key before connecting.
xtra.ready: Shared connection available on your devices
xtra.notConnected: No Xtra connection available for your account
xtra.noAccess: You can manage this connection, but your account has not been granted usage access.
xtra.reconnect: The connection needs a new login or browser verification. Ask a household owner to reconnect here.
xtra.connectTitle: Connect or renew the shared account
xtra.desktop: Open a local terminal on your Mac or desktop computer, not an SSH session on home-server. From the local WickedHome project folder, run this command. Sign in yourself in the browser window, choose your store, search for a product and open your Colruyt shopping list.
xtra.uploadHelp: Choose the WickedHome accounts above, then upload the generated xtra-connection.json file. Your selected accounts can then use it from their phones too.
xtra.secretFile: This file grants access to your Colruyt account. Delete it after importing. WickedHome stores it encrypted. Sessions can expire, so reconnecting may be necessary.
xtra.disconnectHelp: Remove the saved connection and access for all selected accounts. This does not sign you out of Colruyt in other browsers.
xtra.error: Xtra could not complete this request. Check the connection file and try again.
xtra.invalidFile: Choose a valid Xtra connection file generated by the desktop helper.
xtra.searchError: Colruyt search is unavailable. Check the shared Xtra connection in Settings, or enter the product manually.
xtra.prices: Store {{id}} · checked {{date}}. Prices may change and can differ from Collect&Go.
